intro.title: 방 배치 비교
intro.body: 익숙한 방이 어떻게 바뀌었는지 직접 비교합니다. 층과 방을 고른 뒤 격자의 표시를 누르면 그 위치의 스폰 후보를 확인할 수 있습니다.

conversion.spawns: [x,y,[[entityType,variant,subtype,weight],...]]; candidates grouped by coordinates, order and duplicate tuples preserved
conversion.delta: Original changed.delta reconstructs exactly from before/after and changedFields; spawn fields ungrouped to original tuples
conversion.weight: Original float32 values preserved; relative candidate weights and room-selection weights are different values
conversion.absence: null is a missing preset; empty spawns is an existing empty room
conversion.unchanged: unchanged presets omitted; all 52 file summaries retained
